reason: The cited evidence supports the general feasibility of combining DFT-derived descriptors with ML and Bayesian optimization for MPEA property prediction, but it does not provide specific prior results for HfNbTiVAl10's hierarchical heterostructure, nor does it quantify the claimed 70–80% efficiency gain or 15–20% accuracy improvement for toughness, which are key premises of the hypothesis.
premises: DFT can generate accurate descriptors (elastic constants, misfit volumes, surface energies, USFEs) for the hierarchical heterostructure
ML model trained on these DFT descriptors can interpolate across compositional/structural space to predict mechanical properties
Bayesian uncertainty quantification improves reliability and guards against overfitting
The integrated framework reduces computational cost by 70–80% versus full DFT/CALPHAD
The framework improves prediction accuracy by 15–20% for Young's modulus, yield strength, and fracture toughness
